  (:requirements :strips :adl :typing)
  (:types
    area - object
    storearea transitarea - area
    hoist crate container depot - object
  )
  (:predicates
    (available ?h - hoist)
    (at ?h - hoist ?a - area)
    (on ?c - crate ?s - storearea)
    (in ?x ?y)
    (connected ?a1 ?a2 - area)
    (lifting ?h - hoist ?c - crate)
  )

  (:action lift
    :parameters (?h - hoist ?c - crate ?source - storearea ?dest - area ?place - object)
    :precondition (and
      (available ?h)
      (at ?h ?dest)
      (on ?c ?source)
      (in ?source ?place)
      (connected ?source ?dest)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (on ?c ?source))
      (not (in ?c ?place))
      (not (available ?h))
      (lifting ?h ?c)
    )
  )

  (:action drop
    :parameters (?h - hoist ?c - crate ?srcArea - area ?dest - storearea ?place - object)
    :precondition (and
      (at ?h ?srcArea)
      (lifting ?h ?c)
      (connected ?srcArea ?dest)
      (in ?dest ?place)
      (forall (?c2 - crate) (not (on ?c2 ?dest)))
      (forall (?h2 - hoist) (not (at ?h2 ?dest)))
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (lifting ?h ?c))
      (available ?h)
      (on ?c ?dest)
      (in ?c ?place)
    )
  )

  (:action move
    :parameters (?h - hoist ?from - storearea ?to - storearea)
    :precondition (and
      (at ?h ?from)
      (connected ?from ?to)
      (forall (?c - crate) (not (on ?c ?to)))
      (forall (?h2 - hoist) (not (at ?h2 ?to)))
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at ?h ?from))
      (at ?h ?to)
    )
  )

  (:action go-out
    :parameters (?h - hoist ?from - storearea ?to - transitarea)
    :precondition (and
      (at ?h ?from)
      (connected ?from ?to)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at ?h ?from))
      (at ?h ?to)
    )
  )

  (:action go-in
    :parameters (?h - hoist ?from - transitarea ?to - storearea)
    :precondition (and
      (at ?h ?from)
      (connected ?from ?to)
      (forall (?c - crate) (not (on ?c ?to)))
      (forall (?h2 - hoist) (not (at ?h2 ?to)))
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at ?h ?from))
      (at ?h ?to)
    )
  )
)
END DOMAIN
